pages.text: $(thing)Simply Swords$(/thing) unique weapons are the best weapons in the pack. They are $(bold)boss-drop-only$(/bold) — not craftable, not tradeable, not found in chests. Each is matched to a specific boss thematically.$(br2)$(bold)42 unique weapons$(/bold) exist across all 4 tiers. Drop chances range from 8% (rarest) to 25% (Ender Dragon's $(item)Waking Lichblade$(/item)). On average, expect 6–8 kills to guarantee a drop.
